tickets.title: Review recurring payment change request
tickets.text:
Evaluate the requested recurring payment change using these criteria and collect evidence before processing:

Review criteria:
- Confirm the payment type: deposit, withdrawal, bill payment, ACH, journal, charitable gift, or scheduled transfer.
- Confirm whether the request is to start, stop, pause, resume, change amount, change frequency, or change funding source.
- Verify Daria Nettlewhisk authorization and any required custodian form or e-signature.
- Confirm payee or receiving account details without relying on verbal-only instructions for sensitive changes.
- Review account cash availability and expected timing of income or settlements.
- Identify tax, penalty, overdraft, or missed-payment risks.
- Check whether the change affects retirement income, RMD satisfaction, charitable giving, insurance premiums, or household budget assumptions.

Evidence to collect:
- Written Daria Nettlewhisk instruction or approved form
- Current recurring payment record or screenshot from custodian system
- New payment amount, cadence, and source account
- Payee or destination verification
- Notes confirming impact review and approval to implement

Relocate the monthly household cash transfer from the Velvet Acorn Custody money market source to the new Thimble Harbor Custody cash sleeve after the new account is funded, to be completed by 2025-01-15.
